_comment: Single source of truth for all role model chains. IDs re-verified against `opencode models` (453 models, 2026-10-28): every entry present. Ordering is per-role as specified by the user on 2026-10-28; the old global 'fast models first, slow models last' rule no longer applies (review roles intentionally put the 550B model early for depth). chains -> generated agents/* via scripts/gen-fallbacks.py. Do not edit generated files by hand.
_last_resort_comment: Global floor, tried IN ORDER after a role's own rungs are exhausted and before the mastermind takes over. Set 2026-10-28 (was a single model).

families._comment: Critic, code-reviewer, security-reviewer and final-verifier must differ BY FAMILY from EVERY model in author_models (coder, debugger, takeovers). Only the Nemotron group is merged (explicit user rule: Nemotron NIM and Nemotron Zen are one family); every other model is its own family. Both provider spellings are listed so family() resolves nvidia and nvidia_secondary routes to the same family.
